description: This file defines a test sandbox class for the BinaryProtocolServer in the com.rusefi.io.tcp.test package. It contains a main method that initializes a TcpIoStream, creates a BinaryProtocol instance, sets a controller with a configuration image, initializes outputs, and starts the BinaryProtocolServer.

classes.name: BinaryProtocolServerSandbox
classes.description: A sandbox/testing class with a main method to initialize and start the BinaryProtocolServer in a controlled environment.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that sets up the stream, protocol, controller, and starts the BinaryProtocolServer for testing purposes.
